## Driving photos without Immich

`make verify` and `tools/control` (the verify-waypoint skill) run the demo server with outbound HTTP sent to a dead proxy, so anything that reaches for Immich must be answered locally for a `demo` source:

- `GET /api/photos/{id}/original` for a `demo` source answers the 1280 px preview placeholder (`image/png`) with no connection attempt; the demo rows are images only (no video rows), so no page asks for a stream.
- `POST /api/photo-sources/{id}/test` on a `demo` source answers success with the demo person's name and opens no connection; `POST /api/photo-sources/{id}/sync` answers 202 with `started: false` (nothing to sync), so a session can press Test and Sync now without a 503 or a console error.
- `.claude/skills/verify-waypoint/references/feature-gotchas.md` gets a "Photos" entry: demo photos are generated placeholders; a demo library's Test and Sync now do nothing real; connecting a new library needs the `fake_immich` flow step (PHOTOS-UI-SETTINGS); then `make user-feature-map`.

replace.old: - [ ] `make verify` completes with the network blocked (no new notes about failed requests in `artifacts/verify/`).
replace.new:
- [ ] `make verify` completes with the network blocked (no new notes about failed requests in `artifacts/verify/`).
- [ ] With `tools/control start`, opening the road trip, a photo, Open original, and Settings → Photos → Test and Sync now on a demo library gives no 5xx in `tools/control network` and nothing in `console` (output pasted in the PR).
- [ ] A test asserts `original`, `test` and `sync` on a `demo` source make no outbound request (`tls.urlopen` patched to fail).

## A make verify flow for Connect and Test

The demo server can't reach an Immich server, so the Connect form's success path needs a faked reply, the way `fake_labels` and `fake_destination` fake Gmail and the AI (`frontend/verify/flows/README.md`):

- A flow step `{"fake_immich": "Demo Person"}` in `frontend/verify/verify.mjs`: answers the page's `POST /api/photo-sources` and `POST /api/photo-sources/{id}/test` with a made-up Immich user of that name (and a refused or unreachable answer for `{"fake_immich": "refused"}` / `"unreachable"`), lets everything else through to the demo data; documented in the flows README.
- Flow `photos-connect.json` on page `settings`: open the Photos section, fill an address on `immich.example` and a made-up key, press Test, expect the made-up name, Save, expect the new card; screenshots at phone and desktop. A second flow `photos-connect-refused.json` shows the refused sentence on the key field.
